questions.question: What scope should this follow-up pass on #1113 take?

options.label: Items 1-4 + cheap carry-overs (Recommended)
options.description: The four merge conditions, plus #1093's TESTING-RUNBOOK section on Windows ACL denials and its real-denial cases #1113 lacks: Windows ACL (RD) on every branch, POSIX chmod 0 and 0o444 on the flat listings. The junction test needs the ACL recipe anyway, so the runbook comes nearly free.

options.label: Items 1-4 only
options.description: Just the merge conditions. The diff stays smallest and gives the one review round the least surface. #1093's extra test depth is left to BUG-318/319 or dropped.

options.label: Items 1-4 + all of item 5
options.description: Also port every #1093 case that has no #1113 equivalent, e.g. the denied-ancestor injection and the per-errno absence cells. Most of these are injected variants of what the matrix already covers, so it adds lines for little new behaviour.

questions.question: How far should the 'link into a folder the caller cannot enter is skipped' rule reach?

options.label: All five branches (Recommended)
options.description: Flat listings and both recursive branches. os.walk descends into a Windows junction (measured in round 4), so a junction into a denied folder reaches the walk's onerror; without the rule there, the recursive listing would still fail where the flat one skips. The BE-021 text states one rule for every listing.

options.label: Entry stat only, as #1093
options.description: Skip only when an entry's stat follows a link and is refused. A junction the recursive walk descends into still raises PermissionDenied, and that is recorded as a known divergence. Smaller, but the walk and the flat listing then disagree on the same junction.

questions.question: Which Windows/errno codes should count as 'absent'?

options.label: Add winerror 21 and 123 only (Recommended)
options.description: Exactly what the brief names. Each gets a cell that is seen failing first. EBADF stays out: no path-based scandir or stat can return it, so a cell would only pin an injection.

options.label: Match pathlib's full set
options.description: Also add EBADF, mirroring pathlib's _IGNORED_ERRNOS as #1093 did. That is parity with what master's is_dir() swallowed, at the cost of one more rule that can't be measured on a real path.
